header.name: Daniel Castrillon Cuartas
header.subtitle: Co-Founder & VP of Software Engineering, DevSecOps

main.summary: Engineering leader with 12+ years of experience spanning software development, DevSecOps, and startup co-founding. Dual-degree engineer (Colombia & France) with a Master's in Business Intelligence. Proven track record building engineering teams from the ground up, leading cloud-native transformations on AWS, and driving technical strategy across startups and consulting firms. Trilingual professional (Spanish, English, French) with deep international experience across Latin America and Europe.

Led engineering hiring and team growth, defining technical roadmap, architecture standards, and agile processes
